mapper.select: SELECT id, guide_category, guide_type, title, subtitle, cover_image, icon_class, summary, content, tags, difficulty_level, target_audience, author_name, author_title, is_top, is_recommended, sort_order, view_count, like_count, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM t_exam_guide WHERE 1 = 1 AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%') AND subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{subtitle}, '%') AND guide_category = #{guideCategory} AND guide_type = #{guideType} AND is_top = #{isTop} AND is_deleted = false AND is_deleted = true ORDER BY sort_order DESC, created_at DESC

SELECT id, guide_category, guide_type, title, subtitle, cover_image, icon_class, summary, content, tags, difficulty_level, target_audience, author_name, author_title, is_top, is_recommended, sort_order, view_count, like_count, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM t_exam_guide WHERE id = #{id}
